knobs.note: Alert families one medic tick may hand to a model. 0 stops the lane spending.
Backlog depth that raises one alert.
How long a parked family stays parked.

Empty by default since BH-1510.2: the floor runner is the runner on model_routes role 'housekeeping.floor' rung 0, read through bin/lib/lane-model.sh:lane_housekeeping_floor. Set this only to override that row.

Empty by default since BH-1510.2: the model is a database row, model_routes role 'housekeeping.floor' rung 0, read through bin/lib/lane-model.sh:lane_housekeeping_floor. Set this only to override that row on this box/lane; no reviewed min/max, nothing is clamped.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.

Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call, so a cliff or a failure on the standing lane cannot descend into one that costs ~100x (#1141, the $793 descent).

Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend — never from the box's own logs/cost.csv. A second, project-scoped ceiling is the lane.<id>.<project>.llm_usd_cap_day row, which is read only when somebody wrote it.

Dollars this lane may spend in one UTC day, resolved by bin/lib/lane-caps.sh over catalog/lane-caps.conf (now: 90). 0 STOPS the lane; `off` runs it uncapped; nothing is dropped when it trips — the queue waits and it pages once a day. This is the cap BH-1039 added after alert-triage burned $793 in 12 hours inside its session cap. The env suffix is the CAP lane name `medic` from catalog/lane-caps.conf, not this registry id.

Evidence bytes this lane may put in ONE prompt, resolved by bin/lib/lane-caps.sh over catalog/lane-caps.conf (now: 40000). Truncation carries a marker; too small and a family is re-spooled every tick and never triaged, which pages once a day and bills nothing. The env suffix is the CAP lane name `medic` from catalog/lane-caps.conf, not this registry id.

Hold [orchestrator/merge-conductor] alert rows (left unclaimed on the console/table, re-offered next pass) while the conductor publishes kill-switch, observe or no mode at all (unknown). 0 makes this lane ignore the conductor's mode.
